lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The pattern transitions from small, densely packed spots dorsally to larger, more widely spaced nodes in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible, with the primary blobs acting as anchor points or nodes where these bands intersect with the horizontal plane.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 8 to 12 small fish with high-reflectivity silhouettes is visible in close proximity to the ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
